cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: The ultimate small group sailing experience!
what_is_included:
The Aquila 44 is a pure bred power catamaran with a fresh evolution of classic boating traditions. Efficiency in design and performance compliment her luxurious living. She features 3 cabins, 3 heads, spacious salon and galley and extensive flybridge.
A US Coast Guard captain’s license is required for this vessel.
what_to_bring: Photo ID and credit card used for payment required for check in. Captain's fee is $100/hour + gratuity, paid directly to captain in cash
disclaimers: Rates include all taxes, fees and fuel charges. The listed rate does not include the cost for a USCG Licensed captain to drive the boat for you. Per federal law we cannot select a captain for you, but would be happy to introduce you to a choice of local skippers who are qualified operate the boat. The hired captain will be paid directly at the time of the rental.
